topics.hook: People notice you far less than you think.

topics.hook: Why do we keep investing in something that's already failing?

topics.hook: Why can unfinished tasks stay on your mind?

topics.hook: Your brain may be filtering out evidence that challenges you.

topics.hook: Why can a crowd make helping less likely?
topics.angle: Explain diffusion of responsibility with nuance and boundary conditions.
